versions.changelog:
BORT Agent Skill 1.0.0 initial release:

- Enables interactions with BORT AI agents on BNB Chain using the BAP-578 NFT standard.
- Send messages to agents, check agent connection status, and verify on-chain identity and type.
- Supports 10 agent types (e.g., Trading, DAO, Oracle Data) as ERC-721 NFTs.
- Provides scripts for messaging, status checks, health checks, and on-chain queries.
- Includes error handling guidelines and clear configuration instructions.
